symptom: report traceability shows 0 microflow tests for a requirement anchored on a published REST service whose handler's sub-microflow a test calls, and can never link a test to a calculated attribute
cause: document anchors (REST service, page, workflow, …) got only the microflows they name, without the same-module callee expansion a microflow anchor gets; a calculated attribute got only its calculation microflow, which no flow calls
insight: Every anchor kind should reach the same depth: the expansion belongs after the per-kind query, not in one case. For a calculated attribute the 'caller' is the runtime on retrieval, so the retrievers of its entity are the honest (approximate) footprint
